sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: [INVENTED_CONSTRAINT] MainShape sh:or PC6 and PC7 branches: The candidate requires bowDesignForceMethod to be present for applicable ships, but the requirement states that design ice forces calculated according to I2.3.2.1(iv) are applicable; it does not require recording a force-method value. Required change: Remove the sh:minCount 1 requirement for bowDesignForceMethod from the PC6 and PC7 branches, unless an explicit recording obligation is added to the requirement. | [INVENTED_CONSTRAINT] MainShape sh:or PC6 and PC7 branches: The candidate requires bowVerticalSideStatus=true in addition to verticalSidedBowForm=true, imposing a second mandatory representation of the same bow-form condition that is not required by the source clause. Required change: Remove the bowVerticalSideStatus sh:hasValue true constraints from the applicable branches, or otherwise model it as an explicitly equivalent alternative rather than an additional mandatory property. | [CARDINALITY] urn:nltl:generated-shape:I2-010-normal-frame-angle nltl:normalFrameAngle property: sh:maxCount 1 limits a ship to one normal frame angle, while the requirement refers to normal frame angles at the considered sub-regions, which may require multiple angle values. Required change: Remove the maxCount 1 restriction or model the angle per considered sub-region and constrain every applicable value to the inclusive 0-to-10 degree range.
No concrete blocking defect detected in the current candidate.
